tools.name: ul_najdi
tools.description: One search across the eshopmcp hive of Czech companies. Returns products from the stores' feeds (price in CZK, availability, link), services and price lists, how-to guides, articles, FAQ and contacts, ranked by relevance and mixed across companies. Each result states its kind (zbozi = product, sluzb

tools.name: ul_zeptej_se
tools.description: Answers who in the hive can help with a need described in plain words (e.g. "I want to lose weight", "new floor", "move a sofa"). Returns the matching companies, a short answer built from sentences on their websites, the exact pages and their offer; members: painto = Painting and construction tools;

tools.name: ul_firmy
tools.description: Lists the Czech stores and companies in the eshopmcp hive: name, field, type (store / service / app), number of items, data freshness and website. CZ: Seznam firem v úlu.

tools.name: ul_hledej
tools.description: Keyword search for products and services across all stores in the hive. Returns name, price in CZK incl. VAT, availability, store and a link to the item; queries work best in Czech (e.g. "váleček na fasádu", "prací kapsle", "půjčit dodávku"). Prices and stock are quoted from the stores' feeds with t

tools.name: ul_detail
tools.description: Full detail of one item by its id from a search result: description, price, availability and its source, EAN, code, image and link to the store. CZ: Detail položky.

tools.name: ul_pravidla_obchodu
tools.description: Store policies and public contacts for one company in the hive: shipping, payment, returns, service terms, e-mail, phone, address and opening hours, each with its source URL and check date; anything the company does not publish is returned as "neuvedeno". CZ: Pravidla obchodu a kontakty.

tools.name: ul_sluzby
tools.description: Services offered by companies in the hive (van rental, industrial and designer floors, holistic counselling, nutritional therapy, breathing app, AiTop services): what, price and how to book directly with the company. CZ: Služby firem v úlu.

tools.name: ul_nakupni_seznam
tools.description: Builds a shopping list from chosen item ids, grouped by store: links, quantities and subtotal per store. It does not place an order or create a cart; shipping and payment are set by each store. CZ: Nákupní seznam po obchodech s odkazy.

tools.name: ul_jak_se_pridat
tools.description: How a store or company joins the eshopmcp hive: free listing, connecting an existing store, a free store template (Obchůdek) or a hosted store, with the link to the request form. CZ: Jak se firma přidá do úlu.

tools.name: eshop_co_dostanu
tools.description: What a person gets with the free Czech store template Obchůdek from AiTop: package contents, requirements (hosting, domain, Claude), cost and setup time. CZ: Co obsahuje e-shop Obchůdek zdarma.

tools.name: eshop_stahnout
tools.description: Registers a person for the free Obchůdek store template and returns a personal download link (zip, valid 30 days, also sent by e-mail). Requires the person's name, e-mail, what they will sell and their explicit consent (souhlas=true) to processing these details for 2 years by AiTop. CZ: Stažení šabl

tools.name: eshop_navod_pro_clauda
tools.description: Returns the full setup guide (CLAUDE.md) of the current Obchůdek package: configuring the store, uploading to hosting, creating the database, importing products and checks. CZ: Návod k instalaci Obchůdku.

tools.name: eshop_verze
tools.description: Current version of the Obchůdek store template and how to update an installed store (compare with OBCHUDEK_VERZE in www/jadro/start.php). CZ: Verze šablony Obchůdek.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ul_najdi, ul_hledej, ul_pravidla_obchodu · Private data: ul_najdi, ul_pravidla_obchodu, eshop_navod_pro_clauda · Public sink: ul_pravidla_obchodu.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ul_najdi, ul_hledej, ul_pravidla_obchodu · Private data: ul_najdi, ul_pravidla_obchodu, eshop_navod_pro_clauda · Public sink: ul_pravidla_obchodu

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
